metadata.display_name: Nano Banana by Ace Data Cloud
metadata.short_desc: Nano Banana image generation/editing and same-task retrieval through Ace Data Cloud.
metadata.desc: Nano Banana image generation/editing and same-task retrieval through Ace Data Cloud. Configure your own Ace API key. /nanobanana_ace shows help; administrators use /nanobanana_ace_task for an existing task. This integration is provided by Ace Data Cloud.

api_key.description: Ace Data Cloud API Key for Nano Banana
api_key.hint: Copy/create a dedicated key in Ace Applications → General application → Manage Keys. Allow /nano-banana/images and /nano-banana/tasks. No Bearer prefix; never paste into chat. Masking does not encrypt the data directory.
